meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让应用快速接入 Matrix 聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里集成 Matrix 通讯渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Matrix chat channels to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Matrix messaging into your app

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 能按流程为项目添加 Matrix 聊天渠道：复制 Matrix 适配器文件、注册渠道、安装固定版本的依赖包、修补导入路径，最后运行构建和测试来验证。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加 Matrix 渠道集成，或提到“add-matrix”、“Matrix 支持”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 请为项目添加 Matrix 渠道支持。
say.note: Claude 会开始执行添加流程。

say.text: 帮我用用户名密码方式配置 Matrix 机器人。
say.note: 需要提供机器人账号的凭证。

say.text: 添加 Matrix 后，运行测试确认集成成功。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can follow the flow to add Matrix channel support: copy the adapter, register it, install a pinned dependency, patch ESM imports, then build and test.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add Matrix channel integration, or mentions "add-matrix" or "Matrix support".

say_en.text: Please add Matrix channel support to the project.
say_en.note: Claude will start the integration flow.

say_en.text: Configure the Matrix bot with username/password.
say_en.note: You need to provide bot credentials.

say_en.text: After adding Matrix, run tests to confirm.
say_en.note: Claude will run the registration test.
